er_repair.definition: An agreed action that puts a relationship back on track after something broke between two people.
er_repair.example: Their repair was simple: they agreed to talk again the next evening.

minimum_payment.definition: The smallest monthly sum the card will accept. Paying only this keeps the balance, and the interest, alive.
minimum_payment.example: The minimum payment is 25 $, so the rest of the balance stays on the card.

pasteurised.definition: Heated quickly to kill tiny germs, so the milk stays safe to drink.
pasteurised.example: This milk is pasteurised, so it is safe to drink.

si_label.definition: A short piece of text naming an item.

tower.definition: A tall round part of a castle. You can climb to the top of a tower and look out over everything.
tower.example: The castle had one round tower with a flag on top.
